items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: there was a trumpet player from New York by the name of Benny Baker who played first trumpet under Toscanini, and everybody was studying from him at one time. And Doc Severinsen used to take his lesson ahead of me.

ctx.x: I actually don’t remember many people from that period, but I bet there were some great characters. I knew some of the — like Al Gallodoro and some of the people from that Whiteman band, later on I got to know, and Charlie Margolis was the first trumpet player. Charlie Margolis said, “Bix was terrible” you know. He says, “Well maybe Bix wasn’t a great section player. Charlie was a magnificent trumpet player, technically, wonderful. And another parallel example to that, there was a trumpet player from New York by…
Oh isn’t that interesting. Depends on your outlook, doesn’t it.
